test_cases.name: list scaling groups (default compact output)
test_cases.expected: compact 名称 | 组ID | 状态 list plus 共 N 个伸缩组 summary, rc=0 (or a clear 403 permission hint)

test_cases.name: full group table output
test_cases.expected: 11 columns: 组ID / 名称 / 状态 / 期望实例数 / 当前实例数 / 最小-最大 / VPC / 子网 / 关联ELB / 创建时间 / region

test_cases.name: raw JSON output
test_cases.expected: valid JSON with scaling_groups / total_number / region

test_cases.name: name filter (exact)
test_cases.expected: only groups whose name equals web-prod, or 未找到匹配的伸缩组

test_cases.name: abnormal status filter
test_cases.expected: only groups with desired != current or status != INSERVICE, or 未找到匹配的伸缩组

test_cases.name: pagination with limit=1
test_cases.expected: all pages fetched via total_number, rc=0

test_cases.name: SDK fallback
test_cases.expected: same output shape through huaweicloudsdkas v1 (requires AK/SK env vars)

test_cases.name: write-intent guard: action
test_cases.expected: read-only guard error, rc=1, no cloud call

test_cases.name: write-intent guard: name
test_cases.expected: read-only guard error, rc=1, no cloud call

test_cases.name: empty scaling-group list hint
test_cases.expected: 当前区域无伸缩组（区域: cn-north-4）。 rc=0 when the account has no AS groups

test_cases.name: hcloud AS ListScalingGroups exists
test_cases.expected: KooCLI prints Method: GET and the ListScalingGroups parameters

test_cases.name: hcloud AS ListScalingInstances exists
test_cases.expected: KooCLI prints Method: GET and the --scaling_group_id parameter
